quests.title: Housein's Harra Fruits

dialogue.t: Ah, saw my commission at Mr. Effendi's, did you?
Effendi is a man of his word. A commission there really helped me out.
Did you have ten Harra Fruits?

dialogue.sit: Here are the Harra Fruits you wanted.

dialogue.t: Thank you. If I round out my spice business, we'll be business partners.

quests.description: Housein from Sumeru City needs ten Harra Fruits.
